note: Lengths sum routed segments including branches; not point-to-point distances, extracted capacitance or impedance.

limitations: First-order battery-current budget, assuming approximate unity input/output current for gated VCC; regulator losses and radio duty require measurement.
The 2..6 ms frame and current ranges are scenarios, not guaranteed bounds.
No deep sleep or months-long standby claim.

risks: 162 mm class branched SENSE net: board parasitic capacitance and digital coupling remain unmeasured.
Sparse ground routing instead of continuous planes: return impedance and charging noise need oscilloscope tests.
GPIO/ADC critical sections may delay BLE servicing; test under radio traffic.
RF window removes metal directly over antenna only; metal cases, cables, cell foil and hands can still detune it.
